svg.text: Clara and the First Beautiful Pokemon — p13
PLACEHOLDER · characters: clara, pip, moxie · seed: None

text.tspan: Clara, Pip, and Moxie together on a pink cloud, looking out at
the chain of other cloud islands. Clara pointing forward with
one bossy finger. Pip on her shoulder sneezing a happy flame.
Moxie fluttering just above her hand, wings rainbow, leaving a
trail of glitter. Vast pink-gold sunset sky. Characters: CLARA:
5-year-old human girl, short and round, fair white skin with
pink cheeks, long honey-blonde hair to mid-back with straight-
across blunt bangs, huge sparkling blue eyes, big tooth-gap
grin, glittery pink hair bow on the right side, red and white
pokeball-print hoodie, denim shorts, red sneakers, sticky-berry
satchel across chest, big-eyed bright Pokemon-anime cel-shaded
style, default expression is a giant bossy smile with one hand
on hip | PIP: tiny round fire-mouse pokemon, fluffball the size
of Clara's hand, soft cream-orange fur with cream belly, huge
